item_short_desc: Rothco's 58mm Polarized Sunglasses combine style, durability, and functionality in a classic chrome aviator design. These polarized sunglasses feature UV400 protection, shielding your eyes from harmful UV rays while reducing glare and enhancing visibility in bright conditions. Built with impact-resistant lenses, these shades are made to last, meeting stringent MIL-STD 105 standards for durability. The sleek metal frame and spatula temples ensure a comfortable fit, even during extended wear.
